summary: MLD is used by an IPv6 router to learn which multicast addresses its neighbors want. MLDv2 adds source filtering, so a node can state interest in traffic only from specific sources, and it is designed to work alongside MLDv1. This internet-standard text obsoletes RFC 3810.

eli5.summary: It is the IPv6 version of telling the router which groups you want and which senders you want to hear. The router then sends only what you asked for.

questions: how does ipv6 multicast listener discovery work
